title: Greek Pasta with Wholesome Almond Crunch
description: A delicious and healthy pasta dish made with wholesome ingredients, crunchy almonds, and a hint of Greek flavor.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cherry tomatoes to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to release their juices.
Stir in the Greek yogurt, salt, and pepper. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until it thickens slightly.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the tomato-yogurt sauce.
Sprinkle the wholesome almond crunch on top of the pasta and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh basil and serve immediately.
